title: ConsentAccessorScope
description: The accessor scope that describes who can access, for what purpose, in which environment.

purpose.description: The intent of data use. If it's not specified, it applies to all purposes.

actor.description: An individual, group, or access role that identifies the accessor or a characteristic of the accessor. This can be a resource ID (such as `{resourceType}/{id}`) or an external URI. This value must be present.

environment.description: An abstract identifier that describes the environment or conditions under which the accessor is acting. If it's not specified, it applies to all environments.
